chapter: Big Eye Nelson, Lutton's and Adams
title: Jobs with the Adams brothers
summary: After Lutton's he played piano for a group involving one of the Adams brothers near St. Charles.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: What did you do then? Yeah. Adams Brothers, I think one of them was playing up on St. Charlesbury. I don't know what they called it. Albert Clemler was playing drums and I was playing piano. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
Mm-hm. I think one of the Adams was playing at the time for the faculty.
Well I know Placide. Not Placide. The guitar player, Justin.
Justin was playing up there once and then this other boy, I can't call that other boy and then Jerry?
No, I forget his name. And he played what?
